title: Concept: Go panic trace returned to a client
description: A Go panic with goroutine stack frames in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The trace includes package paths, function names and the argument shapes, which is a complete map of the handler that panicked.
applicability: Deployments that render a Go panic with goroutine stack frames into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The trace includes package paths, function names and the argument shapes, which is a complete map of the handler that panicked.
